# Release Automation Scripts (`PriconneRe-TL`)

Reference documentation for maintaining data files, changelog categorization, and running local verification before triggering GitHub Actions.

## File Overview
| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `initialize.ps1` | Resolves `RELEASE_TAG` in **WIB (UTC+7)** (`yyyyMMdd` + `a..z` suffix) and determines `PREVIOUS_TAG` deterministically. |
| `make_changelog.ps1` | Parses `git diff`, categorizes changes into `RELEASE_NOTE`, and emits the `CHANGES.json` data contract. |
| `make_announce.ps1` | Reads `CHANGES.json`, builds Kokkoro's additive greeting from `kokkoro_greetings.psd1` & `character_birthdays.psd1`, and enforces the strict **2000 UTF-16 character** Discord budget. |
| `changelog_blacklist.txt` | Regex patterns for temporary/noise files excluded from the changelog (`.bak`, `.psd`, `.rar`, `New folder`, `[Dump]`, `_AutoGeneratedTranslations`, etc.). |
| `plugin_map.psd1` | Maps files under `src/BepInEx/plugins/` to display names and short descriptions. |
| `config_watchlist.txt` | Watched INI sections/keys in `src/BepInEx/config/`. |
| `story_prefix.psd1` | Group labels for the leading digit of `storydata_<digit>xxxxxx` IDs. |
| `kokkoro_greetings.psd1` | Kokkoro's greeting templates for birthdays (`H-6/H/H+1` for Kokkoro, `H-1/H` for Gourmet Guild), holidays (`H-3/H/H+1`), seasons, and update contexts. |
| `character_birthdays.psd1` | Birthday lookup for all other Princess Connect! Re:Dive characters (day-of only, appended as a polite single-line footnote). |
| `test_changelog.ps1` | Local acceptance and regression test suite. |

---

## Configuring `config_watchlist.txt`
Mod users run an updater that skips the `config/` directory so personal translation preferences are preserved. Add watched sections or keys to warn updater users when manual configuration updates are needed:

```text
[Behaviour]
[Texture]
[Service] Endpoint
```
- `[Section]` watches **every** key inside that section (case-insensitive).
- `[Section] KeyName` watches a specific literal key (case-insensitive, no regex).
- Values matching `ApiKey`, `Token`, `Secret`, or `Password` are automatically redacted to `(redacted)`, and `C:\Users\<name>` paths are masked as `%USERPROFILE%`.

---

## Running Local Tests (PowerShell 7)

```powershell
pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\.github\scripts\test_changelog.ps1
```
